notes.title: Fruitbus Patch 1.0.12
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]
Happy summer, we’re back with an update for Fruitbus! It's been a while since we've done a substantial patch, and it certainly hasn't been for the lack of wanting to. [/p][p][/p][p]Among a few minor quality of life improvements, we've focused on some long standing bugs like where people lose important items or get their truck permanently stuck, and we really hope we've alleviated the worst cases for some of these, so please don't hesitate to let us know by filing a bug report either on the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2484130/discussions/"]Steam forums[/url] or [url="https://discord.gg/P4ntmxpGjt" buttoncolor="#00bd1f"]Discord[/url] if you keep experiencing issues.[/p][p][/p][p]We are eternally grateful to all of you who have helped us with the quest to crush bugs by sharing info, saves and logs, which have been more than crucial in finding the root cause of any and all issues. Your continued support of the game is heartwarming.[/p][p][/p][p]Not only that, but the feedback we receive is so incredibly helpful and thoughtful, and we really hope to have the resources to keep fixing things and making the game better.[/p][p][/p][p]The game will likely not have many huge updates or features added, but we have every intention to continue fixing bugs and improving the experience of Fruitbus.
[/p][p]Alright, let’s get rolling on the new features![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Save Backups [/b][/h3][p]You can now reset a save slot to an earlier version! To access this feature, click on Save Slots from the main menu. Then select the green icon. 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/33936c1dbffe7b1bbf6234a05f96e9dcfb07568f.png"][/img][/p][p]And from there, scroll through your list of previous saves. Date and times of your saves are already there. And yes, this does work on save data prior to the patch ^^[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/967087276679b0dbc9c74df71b74a422ab77eba1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Tool Quick Swap [/b][/h3][p]You can now seamlessly swap tools from your backpack. Selecting a tool slot already in use will now swap the currently held tool with the tool in the occupied backpack slot! We’re hoping this makes your expeditions even smoother! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/ca424f18b5c7196b7b1c97cc86b5bfef58281f3c.png"][/img] [/p][p]Thanks again for your engagement and support! We could not have done this without you. You can read the rest of the patch notes below! [/p][h1]
Fruitbus Patch Notes 1.0.12[/h1][p][/p][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p]Save backups: You can now reset a save slot to an earlier version.[/p][/*][*][p]Tool quick swapping: Placing a held tool in a backpack slot that is occupied will swap the two tools.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Major Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the truck could get stuck with the wheels half through the ground, and the Unstuck function didn’t work.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where occasional opening of the backpack would offset the backpack’s position and delete the tool the player was holding.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where it was possible to make soups from smoothies, but the smoothie would not stop spinning in the pot. Soup is now only possible to make by adding water and ingredients.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a fix to avoid incidents of objects breaking and falling through the world or otherwise disappearing inexplicably. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the dough machine would not produce dough, nor reset if too much water was added.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Quests & Game Flow[/h2][list][*][p]Clarified quest text about the banana topper and returning to Morris.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where quest NPCs were getting stuck on the Time Capsule by the volcano in Banamas.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Tweaks & Minor Fixes
[/h2][h3]Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Implemented a fix to avoid sudden camera rotations caused by lag spikes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where loading the Saves menu was slow due to large amounts of backup saves.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Localization[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where voice lines in certain languages got cut off too early, and a line of chinese voice that had snuck in between one of the japanese voice lines.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of minor typos in Norwegian localization.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the French localization of “shoot” for the Fruitfetcher.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Visual[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Blender and Flatpacker buttons could increase in size for each time they were packed and unpacked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could get stuck behind an invisible wall at the Villa gates in Breezy Bay.[/p][/*][*][p]Added bricks to the previously hovering truck in the tutorial scrapyard.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Functional[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Playstation 5 controllers were not detected as supported by the game and was invoking Steam input.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where typing the letter “R” when renaming dishes would open the backpack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where objects were not highlighted when targeted by the backpack.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the money from a star near the volcano kept falling through the rocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced eruption time of the volcano, and increased the time it takes for the Chilis to despawn so that they are harder to miss out on.[/p][/*][*][p]Brought an end to a repetitious potato conversation on the radio.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Fruitbus Devlog #2
notes.notes:
Summer is upon us!

We’re about to take a two-week break for the summer, and we want to bring you some more exciting information about Fruitbus and its upcoming release. In case you missed it -

[h3]Fruitbus is coming out in October 2024!!![/h3]

We are incredibly excited to show you all the things we’ve been working on and even more excited for you to get your hands on the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/e416fc680176bb15e4e25abeb7fe75780d45aa5c.png[/img]
Before we get into it, we’d like to extend a huge thank you to all of you for the recent response to Fruitbus! Seeing all of you engage with the game, hearing your feedback, and talking to you on our socials is incredibly motivating! We would, of course, also like to extend a huge thank you to Wholesome Direct, IGN Live, and IndiE3 for having us!

Because of this response, we’ve decided that the demo will remain available for the foreseeable future. However, keep in mind, our main priority and focus is working towards the full game. Don't expect demo tweaks too frequently, although we'll try our best! We still love to see your feedback, so keep it coming :)

Now, on to development updates!!

[h2]New Cooking Method - Bread[/h2]

As we’re sure most of you keen eyed viewers spotted, the baking of bread is another way to cook in Fruitbus! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/93a300172c269a8cc976e0be8c02b1964b9bf14e.gif[/img]

You’ll need the oven for this one, and a few other things as well. We don’t want to reveal the whole process here ;), figuring out the specifics of how to bake bread will be in your capable hands. 

Once you have a bread fully baked you can pop it out of its tin, and smack together some sandwiches with it. It takes a bit of effort to get through the whole process from flour to sandwich, but trust us it’s worth it. Your results are some very happy customers and a just as nice payday. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/9011117e60eeeea19e01492cfc4d6a9bb80bea5a.gif[/img]


[h2]Glenn and the Shop [/h2]

If you’ve seen anything Fruitbus, you’ve probably spotted this handsome devil. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/6bf304df24692791b89558068c80c56cc536fd30.png[/img]

Well it’s time to be formally introduced! This is Glenn, the resident shopkeeper of the Gustum Archipelago. Need a tool? He’s got you covered. Stack ‘o cups? Yep, he’s got plenty. Knife? Oh you bet! 

But you already knew that, this is standard shopkeep stuff. What we want to talk about is the updates coming to Glenn’s shop

Glenn has re-organized! We wanted the shop to be easier to navigate, the possibility to preview items, and for you to have easy access to all your tool needs. We’re still working on our preferred setup, but take a look at this. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/ab848d39ae9a1251ff0b249c6e735af469499c2a.gif[/img]

We much prefer this setup to the old one, but we would love to hear your thoughts either here or on our Discord!  


[h2]The Indie Cup! [/h2]

Fruitbus has gotten TWO nominations for this year's Indie Cup,a digital festival of independent games!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/8607c6cf17d3515a68934242426fdc92df28203e.png[/img]

We are nominated for The Gameplay Excellence Award and The Creators’ Choice Award. The winners will be announced at the start of August, and we’re incredibly excited! 

We’d like to thank the judges, and of course everyone who’s checked out our [url=https://indiecup.net/europe/participants/fruitbus]submission page[/url]. 

The winners will be announced August 1st! 

If you missed our submission video for the indie cup, you can watch it below :) 

[previewyoutube=QTAswB9Nt80;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Thank You[/h2]

That’s all for now! 

If you want to see more updates, WIP’s pieces and general Fruitbus stuff, we’ve just gotten a Showcase Channel for our Discord that has brand new content going up weekly. 

We hope you’re all as excited about these upcoming fruit-scapades as we are! 

As always, we’d like to thank everyone who created Fruitbus content this spring! We’ve seen most of not all of it, and we always love to see more. There are two community guides we absolutely adored and would like to draw attention too. 

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EVkgG6xrp_M]Food Truck Fun! | Fruitbus Demo | Preview and Release Information[/url] by Miss Maserati

And

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2484130/discussions/0/4345492131563227082/]14.3 Hours in the Demo Alone, Here are my Observations[/url] by forgottenobject

Both of these guides do an excellent job at highlighting tips and tricks for getting the hang of the Fruitbus demo. Thank you Miss Maserati and forgottenobject for creating these guides, it was incredibly fun to see! 

If you’ve made something cool and want us to see it, do let us know by promoting yourself in our Discord so we don’t miss it! 

We’ll be back soon with another update! Have a good summer, until then~ 
Fruitbuuuuuuuus!

[b]- The Dev Team   [/b]

notes.title: Fruitbus Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Merry almost Christmas, happy holidays, and welcome to the first Fritbus devlog! 

We here at Krillbite wanted to create a fun little something for all of you while we’re hard at work on the bus. We want to show where we are in development, showcase some of the cool things we’re working on and of course shine a spotlight on the amazing community content we’ve seen! So we’re placing a neatly wrapped devlog right under your christmas tree! 

And we’re not the only ones excited! Christmas is in full swing in Gustum

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/81d1db68181a1632e3d2080182e2f5570d7cbd07.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/66cd9f6ede4ad63601f97ee9f1e8c03a3f2de703.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/2c152e6d25dae05f7f61e138eaadee690cd7394a.png[/img]

The response to Fruitbus so far has been nothing short of incredible, and we can’t thank you all enough! We announced Fruitbus this summer, and shortly after took it to Gamescom. Meeting, playing and chatting with so many people was incredible, both for our team and the game’s development! We’ve learned a lot by watching you play, and even more when talking afterwards. Getting to hear live feedback, see players' reactions, and engaging in exciting conversations is exactly why we love going to conventions. So getting to do it all over again at Tokyo Game Show in September was fantastic! We’re all very passionate about Fruitbus, so seeing players be just as excited as we are really motivates us. 

While we’re on the topic of this bus, let’s give an update on the demo. So, when is the demo coming back? 

A date will be announced, but expect to see it again sometime next year! We will of course announce it here when it happens, but if you want to be the first person to know consider joining our Discord! 

[b]Now, on to development updates!! [/b]


[h2]A Fresh Coat Of Paint [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/8592398276edc844ab9e2924e167fda8be549496.png[/img]

A fresh coat of paint is coming! You want to sling the tastiest dish this side of Gustum, why not do it in hot pink? Or race car red? Or cool blue?? The options are limitless! (well, the options may be limited). With the new paint item, you’ll be able to make your food truck look however you want. You can even mix and match! 

Of course, the outside of the truck isn’t the only thing getting a fresh coat of paint! (This is our clever way of saying you can also paint the inside of the truck.) But, we’ve also got some fresh new ways to customize. Introducing…  

[b]Internal decorations. Different shelves in different styles [/b]

Yeah you could place your fruit on one of these basic shelves, But wouldn’t you much rather have… ONE OF THESE! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/2a4468fd9a34b2936f514709500d066617f77934.png[/img]

We have a set of unique themes all made to show each region's personality! Travel to the different regions to get each and one of their unique designs to decorate your truck. 

Travel to Noto and get the charming wooden countertops and shelves. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/46acdf68091ce407eb510f4ead29657c61825c05.png[/img]

Or you could go for something more dramatic and travel to the vulcano to get the shelves and countertops with lava! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/9a92dba2c9d63125a234855047797639546d50dc.png[/img]

Or maybe something more practical and sporty like the camping theme. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/e2953b4be7a22c47c108ad6e45c738da00b785c7.png[/img]

Or our cute pink seashell theme to make your truck look extra fancy ːradiantheartː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/f54e27fa0b258e037d28e4650d506cbfa1a0bde2.png[/img]

Or you know, mix and match and just pick whatever you vibe with the most. Remember to check your local shops, because they may be the ones carrying the unique items for your Fruitbus. We’re sure you’ll find something that really speaks to your bus in the grand archipelago, so keep an eye out! 

Oh, and one more thing. Shelves, fruits and boxes aren’t the only thing you’ll be able to put inside your truck. But that’s a whole other line of product, and we’re not quite ready to show that yet. But keep your eyes peeled for future devlog updates! 

Also… Keep in mind, these are works in progress. We’re still hard at work developing these assets and many (many) others, so what we showed here today may not be entirely representative of what ends up in the final game. That being said, if you have any wishes for future items to be added please do let us know here or on our Discord! 


[h2]New Frying System[/h2]

Stir frying is an artform, and it’s also one of the many ways to cook in Fruitbus. The team felt we could improve this process, so work has started on a new system to Stir Fry. We’re excited about this new take on the system, and we feel this is us going in the right direction. Here's what we've got so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395257/7641c685bb2c71af439c49a16ccafe1aea14eb5e.gif[/img]

The old frying just didn't sit right with our frying fantasy™️, was very tedious and just felt like salad with lots of extra steps and time. 

It had one ingredient at a time, taking up to a WHOLE minute to fry (around 3 minutes for a grandmas stir fry!), then you had to take it out and add it to a bowl like a normal salad. We didn’t feel like we had nailed it.

We wanted a more enjoyable, snappier and fun way to fry things. 
The main goal for the iterated frying was to be able to make a stir fry like you would in real life (almost); frying multiple ingredients together to let their flavors combine and harmonize together in a single pan, then transferring the stir fry to a serving bowl! 

The progress bar on the stovetop has been replaced by visual and auditory cues. Like before, if you don’t stir the fruit it will get burnt and ruin the dish. When ingredients start burning now, they start to bounce around the pan! (they do the "we are currently burning please help us dance"). 

There are of course still a few bugs to work out, and some visual effects to add, but overall we think this new system feels way better than the old one! 

This is very much a work in progress, and we can’t say for sure when this new way to stir fry will be in your very capable hands. We could also, of course, rework this again at a future point. Regardless, we’d love to hear your thoughts on this either here or in our Discord! 

[h2]Thank You[/h2]

That’s all for now! We hope you’re all as excited about these upcoming fruit-scapades as we are! 

For our final little tidbit, we’d like to thank everyone who streamed Fruitbus this autumn! We’ve been watching most of them and had a fantastic time! If you are planning on streaming Fruitbus when the demo comes back, do let us know by promoting yourself in our Discord so we don’t miss it! 

We’ll be back soon with another update! Until then, join us on our Discord for more behind the scenes looks and fun updates. 

Fruitbuuuuuuuus!

[b]- The Dev Team [/b]

notes.title: This new cozy game takes you on a cute culinary adventure
notes.notes:
Fruitbus looks absolutely adorable, and that's usually my number one priority when it comes to cooking games. Don't give me realism, give me cute animal customers. Krillbite Studio has provided just that and more in Fruitbus, a game in which you run a cozy, customizable food truck. From a giant springy banana to racing wings, you can make use of all sorts of silly decor to make your bus more you while you diligently work to fulfill requests. If Fruitbus could be described with only one word, it would have to be unique.
